note: Street-level and near-roof items read by eye off John's 11 placed photos (photo_cams.json), positioned in local metres by the solved cameras and OSM. No photo pixels. Billboard art is our own placeholder, never the real ads.

per_photo.ann_queen_corner: turn arrows (2 white curved) and dashed lane lines on Queen St northbound; signals with green lights at the Ann/Queen junction; Orient Hotel with a roof billboard; billboard on the Mantra podium corner; planted traffic island with hedges and a palm; white 4-storey office (Lawler) left; tall street lights; bus stop.
per_photo.ann_st_far: 4-lane Ann St, red bus lane kerbside (NW side), big figs on the NW footpath, street lights with blue banners, bus stop with shelter left, Orient roof billboard ahead.
per_photo.orient_front: 40 km/h sign, signal pole with green lights, Orient roof billboard, Orient hipped roof with verandahs.
per_photo.queen_st_willahra: green directional sign on a pole at the corner, street light, Spire podium battens and green wall, black canopy.
per_photo.queen_st_podium: Spire podium: timber battens, hanging greenery, dark entry canopy; street light pole; Orient Hotel parapet to the right; parked cars.
per_photo.west_with_spires: pink banners on light poles, 'PARK $9' sign on a pole, yellow-flowering tree, figs, a fence along the footpath.
per_photo.cathedral_forecourt: twin-globe heritage lamp in the cathedral lawn, figs and a palm, brick Webber House with steep roofs.
per_photo.aerial_ne_dusk: red bus lane on Ann St, green median and island at Ann/Queen, figs along Ann St by the cathedral.
per_photo.fly_by_east: Orient roof billboard, Mantra blue swoosh crown, Willahra rounded crown.
per_photo.crane_from_south: Spire top floors in screens, crane, Mantra crown with the blue swoosh.
per_photo.crane_from_nw: red tile/terracotta roofs of the cathedral precinct, Orient hipped roof.
